title: Budgets on the order of billions from TRW and Lockheed interviews
place_text: TRW and Lockheed Martin, United States

tellings.quote: It was on that order from my interviews with TRW and Loheed Martin people.

plain: Secret programmes are said to run on budgets on the order of billions of dollars. A Pentagon scientist named Eric W. Davis says this comes from his own interviews with people at TRW and Lockheed Martin, two large American defence contractors: "It was on that order from my interviews with TRW and Lockheed Martin people." If true, it would point to very large hidden spending.
